tasks.title: Fix LLM monologue leak in ChatQueryService — strip raw thinking/reasoning content from final response
tasks.description: Bug: LLM leaks raw internal monologue/thinking into final response instead of executing tools. Root cause: when the LLM returns reasoning_content or thinking fields alongside tool_calls, those fields are not stripped before yielding the final assistant_message. Fix: add stripMonologue() helper and apply to completeWithTools() and completeStream() code paths.
tasks.summary: stripMonologue() helper added to ChatQueryService - filters think tags, reasoning/thinking/monologue keywords from all 6 code paths (complete, completeWithTools, completeWithCollection, completeStream, completeWithToolsStreaming, formatResponse)

tasks.title: Decouple CandidatesTool from active job titles whitelist — allow screening against ad-hoc requirements
tasks.description: The CandidatesTool was constrained by JobProfileRegistry auto-injection in ChatQueryService, which forced pre-seeded job profiles (lab_technician, mechanical_engineer, software_developer) when intent=candidate_search. Remove this auto-injection so CandidatesTool accepts arbitrary ad-hoc requirements from the LLM regardless of job title whitelist.
tasks.summary: JobProfileRegistry whitelist removed from ChatQueryService - candidates tool now accepts ad-hoc requirements from LLM regardless of pre-seeded job profiles

tasks.title: CTO Directive: Force OTP login on all pages + fix OTP bypass vulnerability (any code accepted)
tasks.description: CTO Directive [2026-10-31T02:35:15Z]: (1) Fix OTP bypass vulnerability where any code is currently accepted — the frontend auto-fills the OTP input from server-returned debug_code (chat.blade.php line 440), allowing authentication without a real SMS. (2) Force OTP login on all pages — currently OTP is only enforced on the chat page (/chat.html); all other routes must require authentication. Security impact: HIGH — bypass allows full unauthorized access.

spec.vulnerability_root_cause: chat.blade.php line 439-441: when server returns debug_code (dev_mode), frontend auto-fills OTP input, allowing anyone to bypass SMS verification
bypass_fix: Remove debug_code auto-fill from JavaScript in chat.blade.php
Ensure debug_code only returned in local dev environment (not staging/production)
Clear any existing OTP values on page load for security
otp_enforcement: Apply middleware to all routes except: /login, /otp, /logout, /api/mobile-auth/*, /api/health, /api/public/*
Unauthenticated requests to protected routes redirect to OTP login or return 401 for API
test_requirements: Unit: MobileAuthControllerTest - verifyOtp validates code strictly
Integration: Full OTP flow works, bypass attempt fails

changes_made: Removed debug_code from MobileAuthController sendOtp response entirely
Applied middleware to all web routes in routes/web.php
Fixed OTP expiry timestamp comparison in MobileAuthController (now()->timestamp vs ISO8601 string)
Updated docs/SPEC.md with OTP security changes
security_improvements: OTP bypass eliminated: no more auto-fill from server response
debug_code never exposed in production (config-based only, not returned)
All web routes require valid OTP authentication via EnsureOtpAuthenticated middleware
API routes return 401 for unauthenticated requests, web routes redirect to /chat.html
Mobile auth endpoints exempted from middleware to allow login flow
OTP expiry timestamp comparison fixed for reliable verification
